name: Office Setup Variant 4
task:
Please complete the following four-stage office task.

=== Stage 1: Supply Gathering ===
You need to archive 8 old reports. Each report: remove staples, shred pages 1-2, file remaining pages in archive box. Supplies: 8 reports, shredder, archive box, staple remover.

=== Stage 2: Document Preparation ===
Print and organize the documents.

=== Stage 3: Assembly ===
Bind and compile the documents.

=== Stage 4: Cleanup ===
Dispose of waste and organize workspace.
